questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb 'to be' for the sentence: 'She ___ a doctor.'
options: is
am
are
be

questions.question: Select the correct sentence using the Present Simple tense.
options: She go to school every day.
She goes to school every day.
She going to school every day.
She is going to school every day.
questions.answer: She goes to school every day.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the Past Simple tense?
options: I went to the park yesterday.
I go to the park yesterday.
I have went to the park yesterday.
I was to the park yesterday.
questions.answer: I went to the park yesterday.

questions.question: Choose the correct pronoun to complete the sentence: '___ book is on the table.'
options: I
Me
My
Mine

questions.question: Which option correctly uses the definite article 'the'?
options: I like the apple.
I like an apple.
I like a apple.
I like the apple every day.

questions.question: Select the sentence that uses the correct preposition of time.
options: I wake up at seven o'clock.
I wake up in seven o'clock.
I wake up on seven o'clock.
I wake up from seven o'clock.
questions.answer: I wake up at seven o'clock.

questions.question: Choose the verb that best fits the context: 'She ___ to the library last night.'
options: go
went
gone
going

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: There are many people in the room.
There is many people in the room.
There are many a people in the room.
There is many people in the room.
questions.answer: There are many people in the room.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct comparative form: 'This car is ___ than that one.'
options: fast
faster
fastest
more fast

questions.question: Select the correct sentence describing a habitual action.
options: He usually drinks coffee in the morning.
He usually drink coffee in the morning.
He usually drinking coffee in the morning.
He usually drank coffee in the morning.
questions.answer: He usually drinks coffee in the morning.
